# Functional DID lifecycle source view

This is the unchanged midnight-did v0.7.0 two-file source closure already
retained at `../../did_adoption`. Every source byte and relative import is
unchanged; `source-manifest.json` retains the same original upstream identity.
The separate source path qualifies functional generation without rewriting
the accepted ordinary fixture or its historical registration authorities.

The bounded slice covers the constructor-derived deactivation lifecycle.
Metadata for all 12 exports and their full generated programs is retained;
that does not mean all 12 exports have fresh proof/application acceptance.
See `doc/rust/plans/did-functional-lifecycle-current-profile.md`.

This vendored view retains the upstream project's original license header and
is classified by the existing `third_party` directory policy. The repository
header policy is unchanged; source hashes and relative imports stay intact.
